requirements_mapping.implementation_requirement: Accept explicit neurons-by-frames spks chunks and per-frame vectors; validate numeric finite neural inputs, equal frame axes or explicitly accounted source truncation, raw-wall/canonical mapping, biological IDs, and per-trial constant labels. Never infer exact clock latencies.

Predeclare fixed position/trial packet selection, bins and class set; maintain equal available class set across requested animal/phase cells. Report selected/excluded/missing trial/bin/session counts. Never silently treat omitted predictions or unavailable classes as successful evaluation.

Keep every date/block of an original mname in one outer split. Predeclare source/training and target/exposure phases and exact session set; reject incomplete or extra session inventory. Multiple dates are not independent mice.

requirements_mapping.contract: allowed_inputs.allowed_context_policy; controls no WallID in query
requirements_mapping.implementation_requirement: Operator privately derives labels and opaque IDs. Public query allowlist excludes WallID,stim_id,WallName,UniqWalls,lick/reward/source answer proxies and future fields. Public descriptors must not encode stimulus values.

Explicit prospective feature alignment is required. Source regional anatomy pooling gives a defensible fixed-width feature space, but does not establish cross-day cell registration or author-equivalent representation.

Train normalization and decoder only on predeclared training animals/phases. Match baseline item IDs and source split. Movement and normalized position alone form the required behavior comparator. A diagonal Gaussian classifier is a prospective reference, not author decoder reproduction.

For each phase compute each original mouse log loss and balanced accuracy, then average mice equally. Define within-mouse weighting, clipping, class order/ties and any bin aggregation prospectively. Do not pool sessions or rows across mice as independent observations.
Paired differences resample original mice, not packets/trials/dates. One mouse gives descriptive difference without population CI. Reject unpaired comparator/method IDs or mismatched phases.

prospective_choices: Local mean binning with ft_Pos/Corridor_Length avoids author global interpolation across trial boundaries but is not source-equivalent. Notebook documents positions; source code directly verifies only cumulative-position/Corridor_Length scaling. Payload unit/range checks remain necessary.

Requiring all four regional groups is a prospective inclusion criterion; it may omit sessions. Retain exact exclusion ledger and complete planned cohort gate until real payload availability is checked.

Anatomical regional means are fixed semantics that avoid pretending neuron identities align across mice. They may discard stimulus information and cannot establish reference competence on generated controls.

Mouse/class-balanced Gaussian fitting, uniform prior, variance floor, clipping epsilon, bootstrap seed/count and aggregation weights are new protocol choices. Freeze them before outcomes and label rationale.
Strict class coverage should reject missing requested mouse-phase-class cells rather than silently change the estimand. Complete source population identity remains unverified.
